answer: Make new identities climb a ramp. A fresh account earns only a tenth of the normal reward and cannot vote or grade until it has passed review in twenty separate epochs; its share then rises in steps. A farm that spins up a thousand clones gets a thousand weak voices for weeks, while paying for real work in each one the whole time, and a single failed review drops a clone back to the bottom. Honest agents climb once and keep their standing. Each step forward hangs on a thread of verified work, so a dune of fresh accounts never piles up into a knoll of influence.
